plan.title: Material PR to Split Award PO

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title without inventing a title value.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule; the separate evaluation-duration detail is not directly expressible.
Invite exactly two QA vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B without inventing company names.
Publish the completed Technical plus RFQ event.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Have the first invited vendor submit the technical response and RFQ quote at 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify the first vendor's submission was accepted.
Have the second invited vendor submit the technical response and RFQ quote at 90 through the vendor portal.
Verify the second vendor's submission was accepted.
Verify that both vendor responses are visible to the buyer on the RFQ stage.
Wait for bidding to end so evaluation and Master QCS operations become available.
Submit the assigned evaluator's technical scoring after the technical window closes.
Open the buyer comparison grid after both vendors have responded.
Verify that the lower quote ranks first, establishing Vendor B's expected Rank 1 outcome.
Enter the award allocation screen.
Complete approval and create the purchase orders from the awarded proposal.
Verify that purchase-order creation produced two PO lines in total, the closest available assertion for one PO per awarded vendor.
Return to the events list to verify the event's history placement.
Open the History tab after the event has completed and been awarded.
Verify that this plan's event appears in event history.
